purpose: Credit the substantial FRANK/XENO/ClayCode/GWT research and implementation already completed before the current Clay 0.1 release program, without pretending that all historical effort remains reusable.

current_remaining_work_prior.derivation: Center points of the current 13-row DOOMSDAY critical-path engineering priors, with Level 0 reset to 2.25h center.
current_remaining_work_prior.rule: This value is replaced by measured current work velocity and row-specific receipts as they become available.

pre_level0_calibration.reason: The archive/repository mapping is not yet complete, so the exact fraction of historical effort that eliminates or de-risks current Clay 0.1 work is not yet known.
pre_level0_calibration.display_rule: Until Level 0 mapping reaches sufficient coverage, show ~73% CALIBRATING with 67-77% calibration band rather than 0%. Do not call this exact.

known_relevant_foundations_already_prese.current_signal: Canonical already tracks FRANK 2.0 architecture frontier, GWT/re-entry, hyperposition, external capability/commit gateway and live experiments.
XENO G11 r9-frank-contract and CC-RC1.1 are already recorded as language/state-transition foundations.

evidence_refs: recent ClayCode multiworker run receipts and commits
known_relevant_foundations_already_prese.current_signal: Compiler/runtime lowering, intent adequacy, resource identity, authority budget and anti-echo work already exists; formal release workspaces being open does not mean this knowledge is absent.
Supported synthetic/sandbox findings and active live experiments exist for re-entry, causal episode identity, hyperposition and GWT lesions.
Historical failures reduce future search space and must receive avoided-work/de-risking credit where mapping proves relevance.

mapping_contract.final_rule: After Level 0, replace the temporary retention prior with the sum of evidence-mapped avoided/reused current-work equivalents plus verified current row completion. Historical hours that cannot be connected to current Clay 0.1 work remain historical effort but do not inflate completion percentage.
